messages:
Clara (Docs): Quick handoff: extracting deprecation strings for v1->v2. Goal: English PR today, localized rollout next week.
Hiro (i18n): Please export a single strings.json. Mark code keys with `code_` prefix so translators skip them.
Luis (SDK): We'll normalize snippets to ISO timestamps like 2026-05-15T09:00:00Z and add `// DO_NOT_TRANSLATE` header in code blocks.
Mai (Localization): Add `short_banner` (<=140 chars), `long_banner`, and `context_` keys for tricky phrases. We will do DE/FR first.
LegalBot: Ensure the timeline sentence uses token {DEPRECATION_DATE} and phrasing is approved. Ping me on PR.
Clara (Docs): Will add /content/deprecations/v1_to_v2/strings.json with keys: banner_title, banner_short, migration_step_1..n, note_model_alias, code_example_js_quickstart. Also a small context file.
Hiro (i18n): CI rule: fail if MM/DD/YYYY regex found. I'll add the check.
Luis (SDK): One more: examples referencing model names should include a short note `note_model_alias` explaining aliasing during sunset.
Mai (Localization): After merge, i18n pipeline will create branches. ETA DE/FR ~3 business days. Back-translation for DE/FR only.
Clara (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1340 (placeholder). Tagging all reviewers.
LegalBot: English copy approved pending final date token.
Hiro (i18n): Pre-merge scan running. Will report results on the PR.
Clara (Docs): Thanks — will merge after checks and legal sign-off, then hand off to localization.
Mai (Localization): Acknowledged. We'll queue translations and keep placeholders intact.
